title: Chrome browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each profile is a separate browsing identity. Profile names and the accounts signed into Chrome show who used this computer and how many separated identities they kept.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, User Data/<profile>/Preferences: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences file that every profile has, so sibling non-profile folders (Crash Reports, ShaderCache, GrShaderCache) are not matched. A profile folder is Default, Profile 1, Profile 2, ...

cleanup.exportFirst: Export saved passwords from Chrome Password Manager and bookmarks from Bookmark manager, so you keep both before the profiles go.
cleanup.signOut: In Chrome, open Settings > You and Google and choose Turn off, so synced data stays in your Google account but leaves this PC.
steps: Uninstall Google Chrome from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Chrome user data folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Chrome profile on this PC: history, saved logins, cookies, extensions and open sessions.
cleanup.source: Google Chrome Help, Sign in to Chrome: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/185277
